acknowledged.reason: Slice C (tools domains), CA 2026-11-25. The aggregate fixture scoreGovernor + tools + fixtures loads every tools domain by design: its keepLive body reads the whole tools namespace, so it carries all 54 newly exposed stateless governor queries (184.7 to 206.2 KB gz, +21.5 KB over dev, +13.7% over 7.48.0, within the plan's +15% consumer limit).
